scope: CALM prototype development, deterministic rule testing, VR integration testing, and UAT preparation
assurances: Every learner-facing unit is derived from a reviewed protocol card rather than a raw PDF chunk.
P0 and P1 responses use fixed bilingual language packs and do not depend on LLM paraphrasing.
Source locators, context conditions, prohibited actions, and lifecycle state remain attached to each unit.
Cards with a known current-source gap are excluded from the development runtime.
not_claimed: This is not approval by BFP, PHIVOLCS, PAGASA, DepEd, a local DRRMO, or a partner school.
This is not authorization for real-emergency deployment.
This does not promote any protocol card to RUNTIME_APPROVED.
production_gate: Only RUNTIME_APPROVED cards whose required external reviews are recorded may enter production retrieval units.
